readings.what_the_screen_said: 这次排不出方案：数据不够，不是你说的不对 +（服务器给的原因编号：CATALOG_EMPTY）
readings.who_actually_decided: the browser: it calls GET /api/v1/places?city_code=<city> first and, when fewer than 2 rows come back, sets status BLOCKED:CATALOG_EMPTY and builds the failure string itself, without POSTing plans/generate — see bundle excerpt 2 and the hangzhou request sequence
readings.control_evidence: the beijing walk does the same GET /places, gets >=2 rows and then issues POST .../plans/generate (201); the hangzhou walk never reaches that POST
readings.server_side_status: the same code name is defined and emitted server-side too (services.py) and is covered by a test, but on this user path it was never consulted
